info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Chloride Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of chloride produce details within the catalog. It allows users to submit new entries for chloride produce, ensuring that the catalog is continuously updated with the latest product information. Typical consumers include product managers and supply chain teams looking to maintain accurate and comprehensive product catalogs. This API streamlines the addition of produce details, helping businesses enhance inventory visibility and product offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit detailed information regarding chloride produce products, ensuring accurate data management and processing within the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide details for chloride produce operations. It must contain all required fields as specified in the schema, ensuring that the information sent is complete and adheres to the expected structure.
